name: app/page-header
title: PageHeader
summary: A page's title with optional breadcrumbs, a "View docs" pill, one line of description and actions. Compact: a 20px title, no rule. The one <h1> on an app page.

props.name: description
props.description: One line, capped at the prose measure.

props.name: crumbs
props.description: Breadcrumbs; the last (no href) is the current page.

props.name: docsHref
props.description: Link to the page's documentation, as a pill beside the title.

behaviour: Breadcrumbs render only when given, as a named <nav> with an ordered list; the crumb without href is aria-current="page".
The docs pill's accessible name includes the page title ("View docs for People").

focus: The docs pill shows the `--ring` focus ring.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Stacks below sm; from sm the actions sit right of the title.
Crumbs and the title row wrap.
contract:
contract
  slot is "page-header"
  when default shows h1 "People"
  when default shows a "Dashboard"
  when plain shows h1 "People"
end

checks.say: The docs pill names its page.

gaps: The docs pill is 24px on touch: it meets WCAG 2.5.8 (24px) but not the 44px the other app controls keep.
